metricDefinitions.label: Daily price and volume
metricDefinitions.definition: Daily UTC OHLCV bars for the named USDT spot market. The latest daily bar may be incomplete until its UTC close.

metricDefinitions.label: Technical signals
metricDefinitions.definition: MA20 and MA50 are simple moving averages of closing price. RSI uses Wilder's 14-period method. MACD is EMA(12) minus EMA(26), with EMA(9) signal. Support and resistance are the prior 20 complete daily bars' lowest low and highest high. Volume ratio compares latest quote volume with the prior 20-bar average.

metricDefinitions.label: Market structure and cross-asset analysis
metricDefinitions.definition: Breadth is an equal-weight count across the selected asset universe. Category returns are equal-weight averages. Relative BTC strength is 7-day asset/category return minus BTC 7-day return. Thirty-day annualized volatility is the population standard deviation of daily returns times sqrt(365). BTC correlation is Pearson correlation of the most recent 60 daily returns. Thirty-day drawdown is the latest close relative to the highest close in the trailing 30 days.
